articles.title: Five Lattes for a World Cup Seat? NYC Mayor Unveils $50 Ticket Lottery Amid Price Outrage
articles.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani is making 1,000 World Cup tickets available to New Yorkers for $50—the cost of five lattes, he joked. A lottery opens May 25 for seven MetLife Stadium matches, excluding the $33,000 final, and includes free bus transport.

articles.title: Landmark Ruling: ICJ Declares Right to Strike Protected Under 1948 Labor Treaty
articles.summary: The International Court of Justice issued an advisory opinion that the 1948 Freedom of Association Convention protects the right to strike, even though the word is absent. The non-binding ruling could reshape global labor standards and trade agreements.

articles.title: Pork Barrel Politics in Maine: Can Susan Collins’ Federal Clout Overcome a Populist Challenge?
articles.summary: Sen. Susan Collins is touting her role as Appropriations chair to secure federal dollars for Maine—from a breakwater in Eastport to combating spruce budworm—as Democrat Graham Platner argues the system is rigged against working-class voters.
